create.name: Iyengar Yoga Dunedin
create.bio:
Iyengar Yoga Dunedin is a small studio in central Dunedin, New Zealand, founded and led by Demelza Campbell, the city's only certified Iyengar Yoga teacher. She came to yoga in Palmerston North while recovering from surgery and working in a demanding corporate role, later passed the international certification exams and has trained at the Iyengar family's institute in Pune. Her own teachers today are Kelly Sobanski and Lois Steinberg in the United States, and she belongs to the New Zealand and United States Iyengar associations.

The studio teaches in the method B.K.S. Iyengar developed, with careful alignment and the use of props so that each student can work at their own level. Its weekly timetable runs shorter Essentials and full-length Classical classes, women's and men's classes, and a slower Well Being Plus class for people coming back to practice; most can also be joined live on Zoom. Members of its Practice Room can use the space for their own practice with sequence cards and recordings. Demelza also leads seasonal workshops and weekend retreats, in Dunedin and elsewhere in New Zealand, and some full classes are shared on the studio's YouTube channel.

courses.title: Essentials and Classical class passes
courses.description: Weekly Iyengar classes in the Moray Place studio or live on Zoom: shorter Essentials sessions for all levels and full-length Classical classes, plus women's and men's classes. Passes of five or ten classes last six months, and casual drop-ins are possible.
courses.price: Classical: 10 classes $230.00, 5 classes $133.00; Essentials: 10 classes $185.00, 5 classes $127.00; casual class $27.00 (prices include GST; concessions for seniors, online and students)

courses.title: The Practice Room membership
courses.description: A membership that covers every timetabled class in the studio or online, access to the room for one's own practice, recorded classes and sequence cards to follow. It runs for at least twelve weeks, paid fortnightly.

courses.title: Well Being Plus class
courses.description: A gentler, slower Iyengar class with many adaptations and props, for newcomers, people returning after a break and anyone who wants a less vigorous practice. No experience is needed.
